test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 02 Jul, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Study the given bar-graph and answer the question that follows.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a80caa9c206b613a19bd126cd845d9feb05057888cd4b28eee4ee83f863d3095.png] 

How many students obtained less than the average marks of the class?
solution:
**Concept Use :-**

Average = (Sum of all the quantity) / (Total number of quantity)

**Calculation :-**

⇒ Average marks of the students ={ (125 × 1) + (130 × 3) + (135 × 2) + (140 × 8) + (145 × 5) + (150 × 4) + (160 × 1) }/ 24 

⇒ Average marks of the students = (125 + 390 + 270 + 1120 +725 + 600 + 160) / 24 = 141.25

⇒ Students obtained less than the average marks = 1 + 3 + 2 + 8 =** 14**
